title: Account docket — quick hits (2026-06-05)
content:
Morning docket + scratchpad for June 5 2026
--------------------------------------------------
Purpose: compact list of customers to push on ahead of next week (QBRs / renewals), quick support tickets to clear, and micro-drafts for outbound messages. Mostly for my head — will clean for Diego if we escalate.

TODAY (top priority)
- 09:00 — prep deck snippets for NovaForge QBR (Wed 6/9 11am PT)
  - Action: pull p95 latency + token cost numbers for hosted-api route /nova-model (INF-prod)
  - Attachments needed: last 30-day latency chart (p50/p95/p99), per-route cost breakdown (tokens + infra), top 3 error spikes with root-cause notes
  - Ask eng: can we get a 1-slide explanation of recent KV-cache change impact? Ping @diego (INF-3421)
- 10:30 — 15m with Arcadia Health renewal lead (quick check)
  - Goal: confirm timeline for contract signature, answer question about Private deployment options and keys (HSM)
  - Reminder: Arcadia cares about audit log retention (>=1 year) and SOC2-compliant KMS integration

SUPPORT & TICKETS (quick wins)
- INF-5652 (NovaForge): intermittent 500s on streaming endpoint around 4/30 — follow up with SRE for kernel-level logs, include sample request id(s).
  - Quick note: user sees aborts when sequence length > 6k, might be batching edge-case.
- INF-5810 (Pivotal Data): embedding mismatch after quantization flip — temp rollback suggested, coordinate with applied-ml.
- Low friction: close out small UI bug reported by Arcadia (console: route filter missing after model roll) — ping @anika to verify fix in staging and then prod rollout.

QBR: NovaForge (Wed 6/9) — outline / talking points
- 1 slide: Executive summary (uptime, cost delta, ROI) — keep to 2 bullets
- 2 slide: Performance highlights — show p95 improvement after batching tweak; note that p99 still has tail issue (we're on it)
- 3 slide: Cost story — token unit economics, recommended batching/quantization profile to save ~18% monthly spend at current volume
- 4 slide: Roadmap ask — dedicated pool sizing options for their 2nd product line (estimate cost and timeline)
- 5 slide: Risks & mitigation — fallback model plan, multi-region failover steps
- Prep checklist: include runbook link, sample fallback policy JSON, callout for 'why not to lower quant too aggressively' (quality risk)

EMAIL DRAFTS (quick copy you can paste)
- To: NovaForge Ops (post QBR prep share)
  Subject: Quick materials for Wed — p95 + cost charts attached
  Hi Tasha and team,
  Attaching the 30-day p50/p95/p99 latency charts and per-route cost breakdown you requested. I've highlighted the three error spikes and included suggested mitigations. If you want, Diego can walk through the KV-cache change slide at the start of the meeting.
  Cheers,
  Hannah

- To: Arcadia Health (renewal check-in)
  Subject: Quick check — renewal timing and deployment options
  Hi Omar,
  Quick note before our 10:30: wanted to confirm whether you still prefer the Private deployment option (VPC + customer-managed KMS). If so, we can have a short checklist ready that maps exactly which artifacts you need for SOC2/HIPAA audit.
  Best,
  Hannah

SLACK MICRO-DRAFTS
- #cs-novaforge-thread: "Heads up — prepping p95/p99 charts for Wed QBR. If anyone from eng has a concise note on the KV-cache change, pls drop it here (2–3 sentences)."
- @anika: "Can you confirm the console filter fix is in staging? I want to close the Arcadia UI bug today and push to prod if green."

NOTES TO SELF / RANDOM TODOs
- Make a tiny annotated PNG showing where Arcadia's audit logs live in the console (they asked for visuals).
- If we recommend Dedicated for NovaForge, prepare two cost scenarios: 1) conservative (30% buffer), 2) aggressive (10% buffer + autoscale burst).
- Revisit INF-5810 with applied-ml: ask for sample embedding checksums pre/post quant to reproduce locally.
- Check linked eval set for NovaForge prompt set "helpdesk-v1" — need to ensure no regression with newer tokenization (possible detokenization drift)

OPEN QUESTIONS (for 1:1 with manager this week)
- What's the expected SLA for early-access customers on Dedicated? Do we have a standard doc to share with procurement?
- Can we get a short blurb from infra explaining GPU preemption behaviour for Dedicated pools (bullet points)

END-OF-DAY WRAP (what I want to ship before logging off)
- Send NovaForge pre-read deck (attach charts)
- Close Arcadia UI bug (or at least have staging sign-off)
- Post quick update in #cs-team about INF-5652 status

FRAGMENTS / SHORTHAND (notes I scribbled)
- p95 target: <180ms for helpdesk-v1 (current ~220ms)
- cost: ~0.0034 $/k token route nova-model (confirm)
- sample request ids to aggregate: rf-20260530-001, rf-20260530-009

If something blows up — prioritize customer-facing comms first, then root cause. Keep one-liners short for execs.

----
Pinned follow-ups:
- Diego: slide on KV-cache (due 6/6)
- Anika: staging check on Arcadia console filter (due today)
- Applied-ML: embedding checksum diff (by 6/8)

(End of scratchpad)
